text: Chapter 15: Coenubia's Awakening@As the Roots Come to Light
■Next Mission\nMove from Grazen Forecourt to\nRuhig Trail to start.
After passing through the Ruhig Trail, you spot the ark\nhovering in the sky over the Wizka Forest!\nAnono is in bad shape! Let's hurry to the ark!
The Wizka Forest is so dense that the trees block your view,\nand you lose sight of the ark!\nBut it can't be far! Let’s find it quickly!
Doy and Mari, two warriors loyal to the Collective\nConsciousness of Coenubia, attack you! You have no choice\nbut to fight! Defeat them with everything you've got!
